framework_support.name: vanilla
framework_support.notes: Bundled HTML/CSS/JS preview and tokens; native means direct web assets, not native OS integration.

framework_support.name: react
framework_support.notes: Map tokens and patterns onto existing React components; no bundled React component package.

framework_support.name: vue
framework_support.notes: Map tokens and patterns onto existing Vue components; no framework migration.

framework_support.name: electron
framework_support.notes: Renderer styling only; tray registration, focus and placement require host implementation and tests.

framework_support.name: tauri
framework_support.notes: WebView styling only; tray registration, focus and placement require host implementation and tests.

framework_support.name: swiftui
framework_support.notes: Semantic tokens, geometry and platform contract; no bundled or tested SwiftUI implementation.

framework_support.name: appkit
framework_support.notes: Native semantic adaptation; real menu-bar and multi-display behavior must be verified.

framework_support.name: winui
framework_support.notes: Semantic tokens and Windows shell contract; native DPI and ClearType remain unverified.

framework_support.name: qt
framework_support.notes: Translate semantic styling to existing Qt components; no bundled Qt implementation.

framework_support.name: go
framework_support.notes: Frozen upstream excerpts support source inspection, not a runnable or tested native starter.
